title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and One
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and One

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3302_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Items (e) and (f) under Group III, for the Province of Cebu, page 193, paragraph (b), Section two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and one are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(e) Tungkop Elementary School Building, Minglanilla Repair and remodelling ₱8,000.00 "(f) Carcar Municipal Hall, Carcar Construction 10,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
